stem: The diagram shows the major stages of the cell cycle and the percentage of time spent in each phase.
instruction: Which statement best describes why a cell spends the majority of its time in interphase?

options.label: A
options.text: The cell is growing and carrying out processes such as metabolism and DNA replication.

options.label: B
options.text: The cell is aging and processes are stopping as lysosomes clear dead cell matter away.

options.label: C
options.text: The cell needs time to synthesize spindle fibers to complete mitosis.

options.label: D
options.text: The cell needs time to complete cytokinesis.

visual_elements: Pie chart labeled 'Percentage of Time in Each Major Stage of the Cell Cycle' with sections 'M phase' and 'Interphase'.
